newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela car sales off 36 pct in Aug vs year ago.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela car sales off 36 pct in Aug vs year ago.

text.p: Vehicle sales in Venezuela were down 36 percent in August at 5,407 units compared with 8,457 units in August 1995, the Venezuelan Automobile Chamber (CAVENEZ) said Monday.
Vehicle sales in August were also down 6.6 percent from 5,790 sold in July, the CAVENEZ figures showed.
Accumulated sales for the first eight months of the year were 38,953, down 27 percent from the 53,222 units sold at the same time last year.
Of the 5,407 vehicles sold in August, 284 were imported and the rest were assembled in Venezuela. Venezuela exported 1,192 vehicles in August, up 22 percent from August 1995.
General Motors Corp led the Venezuelan market with 24 percent of total sales in the first eight months.
